import numpy as np

# Average noisy perception calls to reduce ~1cm random error
def avg_pose(fn, name, n=10):
    ps, q = [], None
    for _ in range(n):
        p, q_ = fn(name)
        ps.append(p)
        if q is None:
            q = q_
    return np.mean(ps, axis=0), q

goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()

# Handle grasp pose and nut center pose (same rigid body -> fixed offset)
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = avg_pose(sample_grasp_pose, "extruded handle of the brown square nut")
nut_center_pos, _ = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "white hollow center of the brown square nut")
offset = grasp_pos - nut_center_pos  # EE-to-nut-center offset in world frame (orientation kept fixed)

# Grasp the handle
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.20
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Peg pose
peg_pos, _ = avg_pose(get_object_pose, "brown square block")

# Target EE pose so that the nut center aligns with the peg; keep orientation unchanged
target_pos = peg_pos + offset
target_pos[2] = peg_pos[2] + offset[2] + 0.0  # nut center at peg height

# Move above the peg at lifted height, then descend to insert
above_pos = target_pos.copy()
above_pos[2] = lift_pos[2]
goto_pose(above_pos, grasp_quat)
goto_pose(target_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.12)

# Release and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = target_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat_pos, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
